title: Solubility measurements for the CH4 + CO2 + H2O system under hydrate-liquid-vapor equilibrium
authors: Hallvard Bruusgaard, Juan G. Beltran, Phillip Servio
experimental_method: Isothermal-isobaric hydrate-liquid-vapour equilibrium in a stirred crystallizer; hydrate-free liquid sample flashed at room conditions, gas volume measured in a gasometer and analysed by GC to give liquid mole fractions of CH4 and CO2; vapour composition by GC.
quality_remarks: Text abstract/conclusion says temperatures 274 to 288 K (conclusion) vs 274-280 K in the results section and table; table only reaches 280.12 K. Rows 274.13/276.19 etc. are listed at slightly different T for the same nominal isotherm. Temperature scale not stated. Hydrate present in all rows (regime hydrate).
